findings.title: release.yml fails on every promotion (SIGPIPE exit 141), so no tag/release/SBOM attachment is produced
findings.note: live run 38490822732 (Release on main @ 7dd0402, 2026-10-14T00:33Z) failed step 6 'Generate the release notes body' with exit code 141 (check-run annotation); cause: release.yml:100-104 runs `git log --no-merges --pretty="$fmt" HEAD | head -100` under `set -euo pipefail` with no tags (prev empty), so git log receives SIGPIPE once head closes the pipe -> 141. Consequence: origin has 0 tags and 0 releases (git ls-remote --tags; /releases), the lockfile SBOM is never attached, and every promotion shows a red Release run. Fix: use `git log -n 100` (no pipe), or drop pipefail for that pipeline, or `|| true`; then re-run the release for 7dd0402. Validation: Release run green and `git ls-remote --tags` shows v0.1.0-<date>-7dd0402.
